# Mookmati, The Silent Earth Studio

> Mookmati (mookmati.in) is an Indian brand selling handmade home textiles and crafts guided by ahimsa (non-violence), inspired by Acharya Shri Vidyasagar Ji Maharaj and his epic Mookmati. Products include handloom cotton, linen and Ajrakh sarees (no silk), jewellery, and hand block-printed 100% cotton bedsheets from Rajasthan priced from Rs 950 onwards, with free shipping across India on bedsheet orders above Rs 1,000. Orders are placed on WhatsApp (+91 94566 01984) or Instagram (@mookmatistudio). Store: GF193, Gaur City Center, Noida Extension (Greater Noida West), Uttar Pradesh, India.

- [About Mookmati](https://mookmati.in/about.html)
- [Contact and FAQ](https://mookmati.in/contact.html)
